title: Computer and networking foundations
milestone: Explain host versus guest, memory versus storage, IP prefixes and a local HTTP request. Continue to Linux foundations in Part 2.

title: Linux foundations
milestone: Navigate files, explain permissions, make a backup and run a small shell script.

title: Networking and traffic
milestone: Explain an address, route, port and HTTP response; connect a local request with its packet trace.

title: Programming foundations
milestone: Read and modify a small Python or JavaScript program, validate JSON and handle errors.

title: Web security practice
milestone: Inspect a request, compare test identities and explain why an observation is or is not a vulnerability.

title: Advanced web assessment
milestone: Choose a focused advanced check, inspect its rule, and verify positive and negative controls.

title: Broader assessments and reporting
milestone: Combine service, exposure and framework evidence into a scoped finding with a fix and a retest.

title: Advanced case studies and complete assessment
milestone: Reproduce a synthetic finding, explain its trust boundary, verify the repair with positive and negative controls, and write a complete report.
